name: The Stuff Fairy Tales Are Made Of
storyline: Paul is a scholar with a thirst for knowledge, living peacefully in a village in the Southern Kingdom. But one day the kingdom wakes up to a sunless morning – it has been cast into perpetual night. Despite lacking physical prowess, Paul ventures out of his comfortable life to find the one responsible and force them to free the kingdom of the plight. Throughout his journey, Paul and other characters that join his party (some temporarily, others permanently), travel, explore, fight and solve simple puzzles to help others and progress in his quest.
summary: The Stuff Fairy Tales Are Made Of is an indie retro-style fantasy RPG. It follows the adventures of Paul, a scholar who, despite the lack of fighting experience, decides to go and find a witch who cast his home country into eternal darkness and persuade her to lift the curse. In the course of his quest, he meets valuable additions to his party, helps people in need, solves mysteries, and develops his skills for the final showdown. The game builds on a classic genre formula, with simple turn-based combat and a special "weak point" mechanic for the main character, learned through experience or from other sources.
